primer: Garware Hi-Tech Films Ltd has shifted from commodity BOPET into an 86% value-added specialty films leader (51% Sun Control Films, 24% Paint Protection Films). H1 FY27 delivered 28.7% EBITDA margins, >28% ex-cash ROCE, and ₹933 Cr cash. At the 2026-11-16 close of ₹7,647.50 (41.7x TTM P/E, +7.29% above 10W EMA), the market already prices in ~17.5% 10-year FCF compounding. Business quality earns COMPOUNDER_PASS, while technical extension favors WAIT_FOR_SUPPORT at ₹7,215–₹7,580 (stop ₹6,520, base target ₹9,300, 1.62:1 asymmetry). Holding Action: NOT_HELD.
